verdict.rationale: Greenhouse documents built-in AI that takes on specific tasks for users. Voice AI runs first-round two-way voice interviews, and Notetaker automatically records, transcribes and maps notes to scorecard questions inside the product. These are narrow, purpose-built AI features rather than a general assistant that users can hand arbitrary tasks to. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product AI assistant or chat agent that accepts delegated tasks, evidence of multi-step agentic actions across the platform, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Voice AI runs a first two-way voice interview on the candidate’s schedule.
Greenhouse Notetaker automatically records and transcribes interviews, then instantly maps AI-generated notes directly to scorecard questions
Replace standalone recording and notetaking tools with functionality built directly in Greenhouse.
